numbering: Single 12-episode season numbered 1-12 (Season 2 is not due until April 2027).

arcs.name: First Days in Tokyo
arcs.summary: Country girl Mitsumi moves to Tokyo for high school with a meticulous life plan and gets lost on her very first morning.
events: Mitsumi is guided to school by laid-back classmate Sousuke Shima and still manages her entrance speech after losing her script.
She and Shima are made class representatives and she gathers her first circle of friends, including Makoto and Yuzuki.
A misstep with the drama club hints that Shima has a past as a child actor.

arcs.name: Class Match and Rumors
arcs.summary: Mitsumi throws herself into the volleyball class match while gossip about Shima starts to spread.
events: Mitsumi trains with the prickly Mika and slowly wins her over.
Rumors about Shima's absences cause a rift until he opens up about his home life.

arcs.name: Student Council and Summer
arcs.summary: Mitsumi joins the student council and the friends head into summer break, while a figure from Shima's past turns up.
events: Mitsumi becomes council secretary and Shima agrees to a group zoo outing.
Shima's childhood friend and fellow former actor Ririka confronts him about leaving acting behind.
Mitsumi spends summer back home and returns with crackers for a downcast Shima.

arcs.name: School Festival
arcs.summary: Council duties and the class play pile up as the cultural festival approaches.
events: Overloaded with work, Mitsumi breaks down and Shima cheers her up with a song and dance.
The class hunts for Shima's little brother Keiri during the festival.
Shima's acting past comes out to his classmates and he tells Ririka he wants to move on.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
